predictions.headline: Zebre's leaking defence points to a home win for Connacht in Galway
predictions.body: Selection: Connacht to win the match. Connacht sit 14th in the United Rugby Championship on 5 points after three rounds, but they now meet the one side below them at Dexcom Stadium. Zebre Parma are 16th and winless, with 116 points conceded in three matches - an average of 38.7 per game - and they lost 12-29 at home to Edinburgh in Round 3. Connacht went down 36-19 at Glasgow on 9 October, so they will be keen to bank a win here. Zebre have conceded 17 tries in three games, and that trend, rather than anything Connacht have shown so far, is what makes the home side the call. Our price is short, so the handicap is the better way in.

predictions.selection: Vodacom Bulls to win (3-way match betting)
predictions.headline: Loftus form guide: the Bulls' 126 points in three games meets a winless Ulster
predictions.body: Selection: Bulls to win. The Bulls have scored 126 points across three rounds - 42 per game - and hold the best points differential in the competition at +72, after beating the Lions 57-15 at Loftus Versfeld on 10 October. Ulster arrive 11th with no wins from three, having drawn 26-26 with Munster at the Affidea Stadium in Round 3 after drawing the round before. Ulster have scored 88 points in three games, so they are not toothless, but they have not yet closed out an 80-minute performance. An early kick-off at Loftus Versfeld, against a pack that has conceded only seven tries, is a hard place to find a first win.

predictions.selection: DHL Stormers to win (3-way match betting)
predictions.headline: Stormers' defensive record should hold up against a Scarlets side still finding its feet
predictions.body: Selection: Stormers to win. The Stormers are fourth on 11 points with a +27 differential, built on 54 points conceded in three matches, and they beat the Sharks 39-22 at DHL Stadium on 10 October - the same venue as this fixture. Scarlets are 12th on 7 points and have conceded 85, most recently edging Benetton 27-26 in Round 3, a match decided by a single point. Scarlets have lost two of three and now travel to a side that has conceded the joint-fewest points in the league. With the Stormers' forward carries and lineout drive working, the hosts should be able to keep Scarlets at arm's length and cover a moderate handicap.

predictions.headline: Leinster's 29-5 dismantling of Cardiff is the form line that matters
predictions.body: Selection: Leinster to win. Leinster are only 10th on 8 points after an uncharacteristically slow start - one win from three - but that win was a 29-5 demolition of Cardiff in Round 3 in which they conceded a single try. Munster are a place higher on 9 points after drawing 26-26 at Ulster, and they have scored 72 points while conceding 74. Leinster have the fourth-fewest points conceded in the league (58) and face a Munster side that has won once in three. With home advantage and a defence that has given up eight tries in three matches, Leinster look the more solid side; take the outright market rather than a tight handicap.

predictions.selection: Buffalo Sabres money line (2-way, overtime included)
predictions.headline: Flyers' 0-4-1 road record makes Buffalo the call at KeyBank Center
predictions.body: Selection: Sabres money line. Buffalo are 4-3-2 for 10 points and have been respectable at home at 3-2-0, scoring 27 goals across nine games while conceding 34. Philadelphia are the story here for the wrong reasons: 2-6-3 with 17 goals in 11 games, the lowest goals-per-game rate of any Eastern Conference team in the NHL.com standings, and a road record of 0-4-1. The Flyers have won their last two games, which is why this is not a bigger price, but both wins came with home ice. Buffalo's home form against a Philadelphia side that has not won on the road all season makes the Sabres the side to be on; the puck line is a step too far given Buffalo's own defensive numbers.

predictions.headline: Unbeaten Oyonnax take the division's best attack to a Montauban side shipping points
predictions.body: Selection: Oyonnax to win. Oyonnax are one of two unbeaten sides in Pro D2, with seven wins from seven for 33 points and the division's best attack on 313 points scored - 44.7 a game - after beating Valence Romans 51-25 in round 7. Montauban sit 8th on 17 points; they beat Brive at home in round 6 but then conceded 54 in a 54-28 defeat at Dax, and they have shipped 214 points in seven matches. Take Oyonnax to extend the run, with the handicap a sensible alternative to a short-priced moneyline.

predictions.headline: Narbonne's league-worst defence (296 conceded) is the opening CA Brive need
predictions.body: Selection: Brive to win. Narbonne sit 15th in Pro D2 on 9 points and have conceded 296 points in seven matches, the worst defensive record in the division, after a 49-28 loss at Colomiers in round 7. CA Brive are 4th on 21 points with a +42 points difference and 206 points scored, though they were beaten 26-14 at home by Grenoble last time out. Back Brive to win on the road; Narbonne's defence has not stopped anyone in a month.

predictions.headline: Aurillac's first away win of the season arrives just as bottom club Nevers visit
predictions.body: Selection: Aurillac to win. Aurillac claimed their first away win of the season in round 7, edging Beziers 25-24, and now host the bottom club. USON Nevers are 16th with zero wins from seven matches and only 4 points, having conceded 222 points and been beaten 38-7 at home by Agen last weekend. Aurillac sit 9th on 16 points and have scored 240, so the home side at Stade Jean Alric is the clear pick despite their own mixed home form this season.

predictions.headline: Unbeaten Provence defend home patch against a Beziers side low on points
predictions.body: Selection: Provence to win. Provence Rugby are also unbeaten, seven wins from seven for 29 points, after winning 34-24 at Nice in round 7. AS Beziers Herault sit 14th on 9 points, having conceded 240 points in seven games - the third-worst record in Pro D2 behind Narbonne (296) and Aurillac (254) - and they lost 25-24 at home to Aurillac last time out. At Stade Maurice-David, Provence's unbeaten home form should be too strong, though the scale of the current handicap line is steep given how tight Beziers' recent matches have been.

predictions.headline: Captain Antoine Dupont's two braces underpin Toulouse's lead of the Top 14
predictions.body: Selection: Toulouse to win. Stade Toulousain lead the Top 14 with five wins from six for 24 points and the competition's best points difference at +73, built on 197 points scored. Captain Antoine Dupont, back from the ACL rupture that ended his 2025 season, has scored two braces this season - against Montpellier and against Bayonne - and Sud Ouest reported on 18 October that he is back near his best. USA Perpignan sit 9th on 13 points and have lost three of six, including defeats to Montpellier and Racing 92. At the Stadium against a side this dominant at home, Toulouse are the clear selection.

predictions.selection: HCB Sudtirol Alperia money line (2-way, overtime included)
predictions.headline: Table-topping Bolzano, captained by Luca Frigo, meet an Innsbruck side under .500 in regulation
predictions.body: Selection: HCB Sudtirol Alperia money line. Bolzano top the ICEHL table with 24 points from 11 games, level with Black Wings Linz on points but ahead on points percentage, under new captain Luca Frigo - the club's 20th captain, who passed 100 career goals for the Foxes last season. HC Innsbruck are 10th on 15 points from 12 games with a 3-6 record in regulation. At the Sparkasse Arena, Bolzano's 44 goals in 11 games should be too much for an Innsbruck side that has managed 30.

predictions.selection: Farjestad BK money line (2-way, overtime included)
predictions.headline: Timra lost the SHL's top scorer to Switzerland - Farjestad's defence should punish that
predictions.body: Selection: Farjestad BK money line. Farjestad lead the SHL with 27 points from 10 games, unbeaten in regulation (eight regulation wins, one overtime win, one overtime loss), and have scored 40 goals while conceding only 11 - barely a goal a game. Timra IK are 10th on 12 points after losing Jonathan Dahlen, the SHL's top scorer last season with 30 goals in 50 games, to Langnau for 2026/27. With Farjestad's defence this tight and Timra still searching for the scoring Dahlen used to provide, the away moneyline is the clear selection at SCA Arena in Timra.

predictions.selection: KAC Klagenfurt money line (2-way, overtime included)
predictions.headline: Captain Thomas Hundertpfund is back, and Klagenfurt host the league's second-leakiest defence
predictions.body: Selection: KAC Klagenfurt money line. EC-KAC sit 4th in the ICEHL with 21 points from 12 games, and captain Thomas Hundertpfund is back after a knee injury that kept him out for 270 days and cost him the second half of last season. Klagenfurt have scored 46 goals in 12 games, while Fehervar AV19 are 13th on 13 points from 12 and have conceded 39 - the second-worst defensive record in the league behind Salzburg's 42. At the Heidi Horten-Arena, with that goals-for rate against that defence, the home moneyline is the pick.

predictions.selection: HC Pustertal to win (3-way match betting; -1.5 puck line the value angle)
predictions.headline: Bottom side Vorarlberg meets a Pustertal team that wins at home
predictions.body: Selection: HC Pustertal to win in regulation, and the -1.5 puck line as the value angle. The Austrian federation's official table has Pustertal seventh on 17 points from 10 games (4-2-1-3, 31 goals for, 27 against), while Pioneers Vorarlberg are last on a single point from 12 games: no regulation win, one overtime loss, 26 scored and 52 conceded. That is a goal difference of -26 against Pustertal's +4, and the gap widens at Intercable Arena, where the Wolves have taken four of their five home games this season. Vorarlberg's only point came in a 4-5 shootout defeat to KAC on 9 October. Our model makes the home side about 81% and prices them at 1.18, so the handicap is the better way in.
